scope: Experimental1214q on 1214p (#14): unconscious NPCs keep their combat channel (the client binds an unconscious replica by exact incarnation and life, without the paused AI state), so a client hit on an unconscious guard becomes a host request instead of a client-only kill (take 1271e).
